# Avyukta IntelliCall

> Avyukta IntelliCall is an enterprise-grade AI voice platform, cloud telephony provider, and predictive dialer infrastructure company with 19+ years of contact center engineering excellence (founded May 2008 in Jaipur, India). The platform unifies sub-500ms conversational AI voice agents, carrier-grade VoIP minutes, Pan-India STD DIDs (011, 022, 080, 033, 079), CRM integrations, and full-stack Business Process Automation (BPA) across 475+ contact centers worldwide.

## Overview & Core Identity

Avyukta IntelliCall bridges traditional carrier telecom infrastructure with next-generation generative AI voice technology. Rather than merely acting as an AI wrapper, Avyukta controls the full voice stack — from physical PRI/TDM cards, Asterisk PBX clusters, GSM gateway multi-port racks, and certified VoIP termination routes to high-throughput predictive dialers and autonomous turn-taking neural speech bots.

- **Founding Date:** May 2008 (19+ Years of Telecom & Call Center Excellence)
- **Headquarters:** Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (A-26, Laxminarayan Vihar, Near Bharat Mata Circle, 302020)
- **Global Coverage:** Pan-India (Domestic) & 150+ Countries Worldwide (USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Philippines, UAE, Singapore)
- **Active Deployments:** 475+ enterprise call centers, BPOs, and automated sales desks
- **Official Website:** https://www.avyukta.in/
- **Live AI Portal:** https://ai.avyukta.in/
- **Direct Support Desk:** +91 85600 00600 (Phone & WhatsApp)

## Core Products & Capabilities

### 1. Conversational AI Voice Agents
- **Latency:** Sub-500ms natural conversational turn-taking with live acoustic barge-in.
- **Multilingual Support:** 12+ Indian regional dialects (Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati) + English (US, UK, Australian, Indian accents).
- **Supported Speech Engines:** Seamless orchestration between ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram, Sarvam AI, OpenAI GPT-4o Audio, and Azure Neural Speech.
- **Use Cases:** Inbound receptionists, debt collection follow-ups, lead qualification bots, customer appointment booking, and cold outbound sales calls.

### 2. Carrier-Grade Cloud Predictive Dialers
- **High Throughput Outbound Calling:** AI-driven predictive dialer algorithms maximizing agent talk time from 15 mins/hr to 45–50+ mins/hr (>300% productivity gain).
- **Hosting Models:** Cloud Hosted Dialers (zero hardware, browser-based WebRTC) or Dedicated On-Premise PBX clusters.
- **Dialing Modes:** Predictive, Progressive, Ratio, Preview, and Manual dialing with automated answering machine detection (AMD).

### 3. VoIP Termination & Pan-India STD DIDs
- **Pan-India Guaranteed CLI STD Numbers:** 
  - 011 (Delhi NCR)
  - 022 (Mumbai)
  - 080 (Bangalore)
  - 033 (Kolkata)
  - 079 (Ahmedabad)
  - 040 (Hyderabad)
  - 020 (Pune)
  - 044 (Chennai)
  - 0141 (Jaipur)
- **International VoIP Routes:** USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Philippines, Europe, and 150+ countries with sub-100ms low-jitter routes.
- **Regulatory Compliance:** 100% compliant with DoT (Department of Telecommunications) and TRAI guidelines for OSP and VNO operations.

### 4. Omnichannel CRM & Meta Integration
- **Direct Meta Integration:** WhatsApp Business Cloud API, Facebook Lead Ads instant auto-dialer trigger, and Instagram Direct messaging.
- **CRM Integrations:** Native plugins and bidirectional webhooks for Bitrix24, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, LeadSquared, HubSpot, and custom databases.
- **Capabilities:** Click-to-call inside CRM, real-time incoming caller screen pops, automated call recordings sync, and automated lead hydration.

### 5. Business Process Automation (BPA) Consulting
- **Free Architecture Session:** Telecom architects design custom automated workflows across all 9 business stakeholders:
  1. *Prospects* (Inbound capture, qualification & AI nurture)
  2. *Clients* (24/7 account servicing, support & renewal reminders)
  3. *Employees* (Automated HR desk, attendance alerts & interview scheduling)
  4. *Companies* (Enterprise telephony, cloud PBX & call management)
  5. *Vendors* (Procurement inquiries & automated dispatch updates)
  6. *Resellers* (Lead distribution & commission tracking alerts)
  7. *Franchisees* (Multi-location telephony & centralized reporting)
  8. *Partners* (Joint deal registration & SLA escalations)
  9. *Management* (Real-time analytics, revenue forecasting & compliance audits)

---

## Transparent Pricing Model

- **Pay-As-You-Go Prepaid Wallet:** No lock-in, no hidden setup fees, no monthly minimums.
- **Second-by-Second Billing:** 30-second initial connection threshold, followed by granular 6-second billing pulses (a 42-second call is billed for 42 seconds, not a full minute).
- **AI Chat Replies:** Starting from ₹0.30 per reply.
- **AI Voice Minutes:** Starting from competitive tiered rates with high-volume commitment discounts applied from the very first minute.
- **Refund Guarantee:** 100% refund on unconsumed wallet credits within 7 days.
